items.q: How does the Fewpips model work?
items.a: Fewpips is a proprietary trading firm offering funding for CFDs and Futures. Choose a challenge, prove your edge, get funded, and earn rewards through profit sharing.

items.q: Where is Fewpips located?
items.a: Our registered office is in St. Lucia — La Place Creole Building, Rodney Bay, Gros Islet, St. Lucia.

items.q: Is there an age restriction?
items.a: All traders must be at least 18 years old.

items.q: What details are required for registration?
items.a: You must register using your legal name exactly as it appears on your government-issued ID.

items.q: Can I open an account under a company or corporate name?
items.a: No. Fewpips operates on an individual trader model.

items.q: Why should I choose Fewpips over other prop firms?
items.a: We're built on transparency and long-term trader growth — flexible environment that prioritises fairness, reliability, and clear rules.

items.q: Does Fewpips have any "hidden" rules?
items.a: Absolutely not. We pride ourselves on being one of the most transparent firms in the market.

items.q: What account sizes are available?
items.a: Standard Challenges: $5K–$200K. Instant Accounts: $3K–$100K.

items.q: Can I pay with BTC (Bitcoin)?
items.a: Yes. BTC purchases are handled personally through our LiveChat to make sure everything goes smoothly: 1) Reach out on LiveChat and let us know you'd like to pay with BTC. 2) Choose your account - select the challenge you want and proceed to the payment page. 3) We'll provide the wallet address and confirm your total with you. 4) Send your payment - once confirmed funds have been received, your account is activated.

items.q: Can I pay with ETH (Ethereum)?
items.a: Yes. ETH purchases follow the same process as BTC: 1) Choose your account and select the ETH option on the payment page. 2) This opens a LiveChat where one of our agents provides the wallet address and confirms your total with you. 3) Send your payment - once confirmed funds have been received, your account is activated.

items.q: Do you accept credit card payments?
items.a: Yes. We accept Mastercard, Visa, AMEX, Discover, and JCB. KYC verification must be completed before your first card transaction, and a 3% transaction fee applies to card payments.

items.q: Are there time limits on the Challenges?
items.a: Not at all. We have eliminated the ticking clock. Trade at your own pace without deadline stress.

items.q: What are the core rules for the 1-Step Challenge?
items.a: 10% profit target, 4% daily loss limit, 6%–10% max loss (account size-dependent), 2-5 trading days minimum (account size-dependent), EAs allowed with pre-approval.

items.q: What are the core rules for the 2-Step Challenge?
items.a: Phase 1: 8% target. Phase 2: 5% target. 4% daily loss, 8% max loss, 5 days minimum per phase.

items.q: How does the 3-Step Challenge differ?
items.a: Three phases with 8% / 4% / 4% profit targets. 5% daily loss limit, 8% max loss, 5 days per phase.

items.q: What is the 40% Consistency Rule?
items.a: No single trading day's profit may exceed 40% of your total profit for the cycle. Ensures consistent performance, not one lucky trade.

items.q: What's the difference between Daily Loss Limit and Maximum Loss Limit?
items.a: Daily Loss is a per-day cap that resets at 00:00 server time. Maximum Loss is a trailing drawdown based on your highest point of equity.

items.q: What happens if I breach a loss limit?
items.a: If you breach your daily loss limit your account is automatically paused until the server resets. If you breach your daily loss limit twice within 7 days, you will breach your account and it will be closed. If you breach your Maximum loss limit your account is automatically closed.

items.q: Can I reset my account?
items.a: No. None of our accounts can be reset, CFD or Futures-Based CFD. Once an account breaches, it is closed and a new account has to be purchased. This is separate from a cycle reset, which is one of the remedies applied when a payout is blocked by the consistency rule and does not close the account.

items.q: What qualifies as an Active Trading Day?
items.a: A day is only validated if it contains at least one trade held open for 3 minutes or more.

items.q: Can I get funded in less than 5 days if I hit the target?
items.a: No. Even if you reach the 10% target on day one, you must still complete at least 5 separate trading days.

items.q: Is news trading allowed?
items.a: No. News trading is strictly prohibited across all Fewpips account types and phases.

items.q: Am I permitted to use a VPN or VPS?
items.a: Yes. You are permitted to use VPN as long as the IP address is not from a restricted jurisdiction. Traders are welcome to use a VPN across all Fewpips Challenge and Funded accounts. For VPS, you must purchase the Add-on at the time of purchasing your account. This cannot be added after purchase.

items.q: Are Expert Advisors (EAs) allowed?
items.a: Yes. Fewpips supports EAs provided they comply with our ethical trading standards. Prior approval required. If you wish to use an EA, please email support@fewpips.com outlining your strategy.

items.q: Which trading activities are strictly prohibited?
items.a: Please visit our https://www.fewpips.com/legal/ page to view all prohibited activities.

items.q: What makes the Instant Account unique?
items.a: No pre-qualification period — credentials are sent immediately after purchase. Skip the test, start trading.

items.q: What's the Instant profit split?
items.a: Tier 1 Split: 70% – First 3 successful withdrawals. Tier 2 Split: 80% – Next 3 successful withdrawals. Tier 3 Split: 90% – After 6 consecutive withdrawals.

items.q: What is the 5% Growth rule for Instant?
items.a: If your account grows 5%+ from starting balance, you can request a reward immediately on-demand. Below 5% requires the full 14-day cycle.

items.q: How much does each Instant account cost?
What rules apply on Instant accounts?
items.a: 5–10% max loss (size-dependent), 2–5 minimum trading days, 40% consistency rule. The $100K Instant account is an exception: no consistency rule, no maximum withdrawal cap, and Copy Trading and EAs are permitted when purchased as add-ons for that account (must seek approval from Fewpips). To ensure you are compliant with all rules, please review our https://www.fewpips.com/legal/.

items.q: Is there a passing reward for Instant?
items.a: There is no passing reward for instant accounts as it is instantly funded.

items.q: How soon can I withdraw profits on a CFD or Futures-Based CFD Instant account?
items.a: Every Instant account has two routes: the standard cycle, every 14 calendar days, or On-Demand, any time your balance is more than 5% above your starting balance. Futures-Based CFD Instant accounts have a third: every 7 days with the Bi-Weekly Reward Add-On. You also need to have met the minimum trading days for your account size (2-5 days depending on size), and a day only counts if at least one trade was held open for 3 minutes or more. The 5% figure is the On-Demand trigger only, not a general eligibility threshold.

items.q: What are the drawdown limits on a $3,000 Instant account?
items.a: The trailing Max Loss Limit on a $3,000 Instant account is 5%, and there is no daily loss limit on Instant accounts.

items.q: Does the Instant Funded CFD account have a consistency rule?
items.a: Yes. On CFD funded accounts, no single day's profit may exceed 40% of the cycle's total profit (on Futures-Based CFD accounts the threshold is 50%). Breaching it does not breach or terminate the account; it prevents the payout until your total cycle profit grows enough to bring that day back under the threshold. The Increase Consistency Rule add-on raises the threshold by 10% and must be purchased at checkout. The new $100K CFD Instant account has no consistency rule.

items.q: Is the Max Loss Limit on an Instant Funded account trailing?
items.a: Yes. Every Fewpips account uses a trailing drawdown; there is no static or fixed-drawdown option anywhere in the product range. The limit is applied to the highest equity your account has reached, not your starting balance, and is recalculated continuously. This means the dollar value of your drawdown allowance widens as the account grows, and the floor rises with it and does not come back down.

items.q: How long does payout processing take?
items.a: We strive to authorise and process all withdrawal requests within 24 hours or less.

items.q: When can I request a payout?
items.a: You must be in profit, meet the minimum trading days (depending on your account and size), have at least 25 closed positions on the account, complete the designated cycle, and adhere to all rules. A payout request on an account with fewer than 25 closed positions is declined and the account breached. To ensure you are compliant with all rules, please review our https://www.fewpips.com/legal/.

items.q: Does my account stay mine after passing?
items.a: Yes. Funded accounts remain yours indefinitely if risk guidelines are followed — no requalification required.

items.q: Are there profit targets after I'm funded?
items.a: No. Once you obtain a Fewpips Funded Account, there is no profit target.

items.q: What payout methods are supported?
items.a: Our payout method is cryptocurrency and the following cryptos can be selected when withdrawing: USDT (ERC20 Network), USDC (ERC20 Network) and BTC. Minimum withdrawal $100 USD.

items.q: Can I withdraw part of my balance?
items.a: Yes. Payouts can be partial or full - you choose the amount, subject to a $100 USD minimum and no open positions at the time of the request. Your Max Loss Limit is trailing and does not reset when you withdraw, so leave enough equity above your MLL floor to keep trading.

items.q: When do I complete KYC?
items.a: Identity verification must be completed before you purchase an account with Fewpips if you are paying with Credit/Debit card. If you are purchasing a challenge with cryptocurrency, KYCs are not required.

items.q: How is the trading cycle calculated?
items.a: Your cycle does not start when you buy the account. It begins the moment you place your first trade.

items.q: What is the Fewpips Add-On feature?
items.a: Optional features you can purchase at checkout to customise your trading plan — reduce profit target, lock in 95% split, double your balance, and more.

items.q: What is the 95% Lifetime Reward Add-On?
items.a: Locks in a massive 95% share of all future profits for the lifetime of that account. Cost: +30% of the challenge fee.

items.q: How does the No Minimum Trading Days Add-On work?
items.a: Removes the 5-day minimum entirely — you get funded immediately once the profit target is reached. Cost: +25% of the challenge fee.

items.q: What is the 150% Reward Add-On?
items.a: Fewpips pays 150% of your initial fee as a passing reward at your first payout. Cost: +10% of the challenge fee.

items.q: How does the Bi-Weekly Reward Add-On work?
items.a: Reduces your Instant Futures payout cycle from 14 days to every 7 days. Available exclusively on Futures Instant accounts. Cost: +25% of the challenge fee.

items.q: What is the Increase Consistency Rule Add-On?
items.a: Raises your consistency threshold by 10%, so a single day can make up a larger share of your cycle profit (for example 50% instead of 40% on CFD funded accounts). It must be purchased at checkout with your account. Cost: +12.5% of the challenge fee.

items.q: What is Fewpips Futures?
items.a: Fewpips Futures is our Futures-based CFD program — trade 41 instruments across indices, metals, energies, agricultural commodities, European bonds, and volatility products with no overnight swap fees. Payouts as fast as every 5 business days on 1-Step, every 14 days or grow your account by 5% or more for an on-demand payout on an Instant Account.

items.q: How does Futures differ from the standard CFD challenges?
items.a: Futures uses contract-style pricing (financing baked into the contract — no swap fees) and gives access to 41 futures-based CFD symbols. Both Futures and CFD share the same up-to-90% profit split structure. Futures pays every 5 business days (1-Step) or every 14 days (Instant, with Add-On / On-Demand options); CFD covers forex, indices, commodities, and crypto with on-demand or 14-day payouts.

items.q: What Futures account types are available?
items.a: Two paths: 1-Step ($25K–$100K) — a single-phase evaluation with a 5% profit target — and Instant Account ($10K–$60K) — direct funded access with no evaluation.

items.q: What account sizes can I trade on Futures?
items.a: 1-Step: $25K, $50K, $100K. Instant Account: $10K, $30K, $60K.

items.q: What is the Futures profit split?
items.a: Up to 90% to the trader. 80% on the first 3 withdrawals, then 90% from the 4th onwards. Applies on all withdrawals from the funded account.

items.q: How often can I request a Futures payout?
items.a: On 1-Step, every 5 business days. On Instant, every 14 days — or every 7 days with the Add-On, or on-demand any time the account is up 5% from start.

items.q: What is the minimum withdrawal on Futures?
items.a: $100 USD per request. Payouts processed in USDT (ERC20 Network), USDC (ERC20 Network) and BTC.

items.q: Are there overnight swap fees on Futures?
items.a: No. Financing is built into the contract price — just like real futures. You won't see surprise swap charges hitting your P&L overnight.

items.q: Can I trade fractional contracts?
items.a: Yes. Fewpips Futures supports fractional contract sizing for precise risk management — no need to commit to full contract increments like with exchange-listed futures.

items.q: What instruments can I trade on Futures?
items.a: 41 symbols across 7 categories: equity indices, metals, energies, soft and grain commodities, European bonds, and volatility products (e.g. VIX-style instruments).

items.q: Is news trading allowed on Futures accounts?
items.a: No. The same rule applies across all Fewpips programs — news trading during high-impact events is prohibited.

items.q: Are EAs allowed on Futures accounts?
items.a: Yes. EAs are permitted on Futures with prior approval, subject to the same ethical trading standards as the CFD program.

items.q: What are the payout rules for Futures-Based CFD, and is there a buffer requirement?
items.a: Profit split is 80% on your first three payouts and 90% from the fourth onwards. Minimum withdrawal is $100, withdrawals can be partial or full and you choose the amount, a 3% processing fee applies, and you cannot have open positions when the request is made. On the buffer: there is no fixed buffer percentage, but there is a hard practical constraint. Your Max Loss Limit floor is set against the highest equity your account has reached, and a withdrawal does not move that floor down. If you withdraw an amount that drops your equity below the floor, the payout engine will still process the withdrawal and the account will then breach automatically. So you must leave enough equity above your MLL floor to survive the withdrawal. Check your current floor before requesting.

items.q: Can I reset my account?
items.a: No. None of our accounts can be reset, CFD or Futures-Based CFD. Once an account breaches, it is closed and a new account has to be purchased. This is separate from a cycle reset, which is one of the remedies applied when a payout is blocked by the consistency rule and does not close the account.

items.q: How soon can I withdraw profits on a CFD or Futures-Based CFD Instant account?
items.a: Every Instant account has two routes: the standard cycle, every 14 calendar days, or On-Demand, any time your balance is more than 5% above your starting balance. Futures-Based CFD Instant accounts have a third: every 7 days with the Bi-Weekly Reward Add-On. You also need to have met the minimum trading days for your account size (2-5 days depending on size), and a day only counts if at least one trade was held open for 3 minutes or more. The 5% figure is the On-Demand trigger only, not a general eligibility threshold.

items.q: Is the Max Loss Limit on an Instant Funded account trailing?
items.a: Yes. Every Fewpips account uses a trailing drawdown; there is no static or fixed-drawdown option anywhere in the product range. The limit is applied to the highest equity your account has reached, not your starting balance, and is recalculated continuously. This means the dollar value of your drawdown allowance widens as the account grows, and the floor rises with it and does not come back down.

items.q: Can I withdraw part of my balance?
items.a: Yes. Payouts can be partial or full. You choose the amount, subject to a $100 minimum, a 3% processing fee and no open positions at the time of request.

items.q: How much should I leave in the account?
items.a: Your Max Loss Limit is calculated from the highest equity your account has reached, and it does not reset when you withdraw. Any amount you take out reduces your equity while the MLL floor stays where it is. Requests that would take your equity below the floor are still processed, and the account will breach as a result. Always leave enough equity above your MLL floor to keep trading.

items.q: Does Fewpips have an Affiliate program?
items.a: Yes. We offer a rewarding 3-tier affiliate program with recurring commissions and sub-affiliate earnings.

items.q: Who can become a Fewpips Affiliate?
items.a: Anyone can apply — no minimum audience size required.

items.q: How is commission structured?
items.a: Three tiers: Launch (10%/2.5%/2.5%), Pro (15%/2.5%/2.5%), Titan (20%/2.5%/2.5%) — across direct, Level 2, and Level 3 referrals. Automatic tier upgrades based on volume.

items.q: Are commissions recurring?
items.a: Yes. Unlike one-time referral programs, Fewpips pays recurring commissions on every challenge purchase from your referrals.

items.q: When and how can affiliates withdraw?
items.a: Withdraw any time through the dashboard. Minimum payout $100. Cryptocurrency only. Processed within 24–48 hours.

items.q: Are there withdrawal fees?
items.a: Fewpips does not charge withdrawal fees. Standard blockchain network fees are deducted.
